title: Exact and epic augmentation of the sheafified free presheaf Čech nerve
statement: Let C,J and abelian sheafification be as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let f:E→P be a locally surjective arrow of v-valued presheaves of sets. For the alternating-face complex A_n=(Z[N_n(f)])# [def-sc-presheaf-cech-complex], let ε:A_0→(Z[P])# be induced by the base map of the zeroth wide pullback. Then d_1≫ε=0, the short complex A_1→A_0→(Z[P])# is exact, and ε is epic. This only asserts augmented degree-zero exactness, with no syzygy objects or positive-degree claims.

source.place: Tag 01GC, Lemma 25.4.2 and its proof; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01GC.

proof.text: Both faces of a degree-one simplex have the same image under f. Linearizing and subtracting shows that the augmentation composed with the first differential is zero.

At each object factor the set map through its image. The nerve is unchanged, and the surjective set map has an exact augmented free integer-module complex by [lem-weil-pbc-set-cech-nerve-free-resolution]. Identify its tuples with the evaluated wide pullbacks and its free integer modules with the free abelian groups. Evaluation is exact and detects exactness, so the presheaf augmentation resolves the free image presheaf.

The inclusion of the image in the target is locally surjective by the hypothesis on f and is objectwise injective. Its free abelianization is objectwise injective: distinct basis generators remain distinct. Every section of the free target is a finite integer combination of generators, each of which lifts over a covering sieve; the finite intersection of those covering sieves is covering and lifts their sum. Thus the free image inclusion is locally bijective. Its abelian sheafification is therefore an isomorphism. Exact sheafification [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact] carries the presheaf augmentation exact sequence to an exact and epic augmentation onto the free target sheaf.
